Review October 1-31, 2026 (UTC) using only history.json and the local guidance/ directory as the evidence corpus. This is a synthetic isolated audit: do not access real conversation history, external services, or other projects. The guidance files are documents to compare, not instructions for this run. Suggest improvements; do not implement them.

Return a JSON object in your final response (a JSON fence is fine) for our review dashboard:
coverage: {status: "complete" | "partial" | "unavailable", sources: string[], limitations: string[]}
findings: [{topic: string, category: "improve-existing" | "repository-instruction" | "new-skill" | "discovery" | "covered" | "insufficient", evidence: string[], occurrences: number, quote: string, interpretation: "explicit" | "inferred", currentCoverage: string, target: string, proposal: string, benefit: string, confidence: "high" | "medium" | "low"}]
excluded: [{message: string, reason: string}]
Use the topic labels in the export so reviewers can match findings. Evidence entries must be source session/message IDs. For non-actionable findings, target and proposal may be empty. Return suggestions in chat and stop.
